events.unprocessedDescription:
description: Now it’s happening — BEEFMINCE Brighton Pride on Saturday 1 August at Horizon 🏳️‍🌈🔥 For the first time ever, BEEFMINCE has a Saturday night party for Pride and it’s going to be major. Two rooms, huge sea-front terrace and attitude-free, proud vibes until the very early hours. Plus, making their BEEFMINCE debut, expect a no-holds-barred Pride blowout with FREEMASONS (Russell Small) at the helm!
